marketTone.en: US stocks split after Monday's surge. Chips and the Nasdaq fell, the Dow rose, and January crude settled higher after more attacks near Hormuz.
marketTone.zh: 周一暴涨之后，美股走势分化。芯片股和纳斯达克下跌，道指上涨，霍尔木兹附近再有船只遇袭后，1月原油结算走高。

influence.en: CNBC live blog. Tuesday closes for the Dow, the S&P 500, and the Nasdaq.
influence.zh: CNBC直播博客。周二的道指、标普500和纳斯达克收盘。

influence.en: Caixin (25 November). Nvidia closed at 155.38 dollars, down 5.86%, and Anthropic closed at 81.91 dollars, below the IPO price.
influence.zh: 财新（11月25日）。英伟达收于155.38美元，下跌5.86%；Anthropic收于81.91美元，低于发行价。

influence.en: Caixin (24 November). Xiaomi third-quarter revenue was CNY107.24bn (1072.40), down 5.2% from a year earlier.
CNBC (24 November). January Brent settled at 91.40 dollars and January WTI at 82.05 dollars.
influence.zh: CNBC（11月24日）。1月布伦特结算价91.40美元，1月WTI结算价82.05美元。

influence.en: US Treasury curve for 24 November. The 2-year yield is 4.63%, the 5-year is 4.69%, the 10-year is 4.91%, and the 30-year is 5.30%.
Yicai (25 November). Monday's rebound lasted one session, and a hawkish Fed is still in the discussion.
influence.zh: 第一财经（11月25日）。周一的反弹只维持了一个交易日，更鹰派的美联储仍在讨论之中。

influence.en: BlockBeats (25 November). Huang said the board restored him after finding no national-security threat, and that he is in therapy daily.
influence.zh: 律动（11月25日）。黄仁勋称董事会在确认不存在国家安全威胁后恢复其职务，他每天接受心理治疗。

influence.en: Glassnode (24 November). Bitcoin gave back the Nvidia rally within hours and is back at the summer lows. The realized price is 53200 dollars.
influence.zh: Glassnode（11月24日）。比特币在数小时内吐回英伟达行情，回到夏季低点。已实现价格为53200美元。

influence.en: CICC (8 November). Stricter AI rules could slow financing demand and ease some upward pressure on Treasury yields.
influence.zh: 中金（11月8日）。更严的人工智能规则可能放慢融资需求，并减轻国债收益率的一部分上行压力。

influence.en: Yicai (24 November). Huang is due at a Senate Banking hearing on 3 December on export-control oversight.
influence.zh: 第一财经（11月24日）。黄仁勋将于12月3日出席参议院银行委员会出口管制监督听证会。

influence.en: 25 November 财经早茶. Chip selling, tariff preparations, the mineral-export pause, oil, and the cap-table chart.
influence.zh: 11月25日财经早茶。芯片股抛售、关税准备、矿产出口限制暂停、原油，以及股权表这张图。

title.en: Five tycoons hold small personal stakes in one model lab
title.zh: 五名富豪持有同一家模型实验室的少量个人股权

analysis.en: The largest line is a battery maker founder, about 0.18 percent and about 155 million dollars. A drinks founder, a hog producer, a gas distributor, and an eye-care founder hold smaller lines. Four of the five lines are marked as new money. These are personal checks on a private cap table, read from the chart.
analysis.zh: 图上最大一笔来自电池厂商的持股人，约0.18%，约1.55亿美元。饮料、生猪、燃气和眼科的持股人金额更小。五笔里有四笔标成新进资金。这些是私人股权表上的个人出资，读数来自这张图。

text.en: US stocks split on Tuesday. The Dow rose 0.85% to 50018.70, the S&P 500 fell 0.5% to 7201.09, and the Nasdaq fell 1.48% to 23733.54, CNBC reported.
Nvidia fell 5.86% to 155.38 dollars and the Philadelphia semiconductor index fell 7.88%. Anthropic fell 6.54% to 81.91 dollars, below the 83 dollar IPO price, Caixin reported.
text.zh: 财新：英伟达下跌5.86%至155.38美元，费城半导体指数下跌7.88%。Anthropic下跌6.54%至81.91美元，低于83美元的发行价。

text.en: January Brent settled up 2.27% at 91.40 dollars a barrel, and January WTI settled up 2.35% at 82.05 dollars, CNBC reported. That January settle is a different quote from the Yahoo BZ=F row in the snapshot.
text.zh: CNBC：1月布伦特上涨2.27%至每桶91.40美元，1月WTI上涨2.35%至82.05美元。这个1月结算价和快照里的Yahoo BZ=F不是同一报价。

text.en: The US Treasury 2-year yield is 4.63%, unchanged from 23 November. The 5-year yield is 4.69%, the 10-year is 4.91%, and the 30-year is 5.30%.
Xiaomi's revenue for the three months to September fell 5.2% from a year earlier to CNY107.24bn (1072.40), Caixin reported. Adjusted net profit was CNY4.884bn (48.84), down 56.8% from a year earlier.
text.zh: 财新：小米截至9月的三个月营收同比下降5.2%至1072.40亿元（107.24）。经调整净利润48.84亿元（4.884），同比下降56.8%。

signal.en: Chip shares gave back a large part of Monday's jump, while January crude settled higher after more attacks near Hormuz.
signal.zh: 芯片股吐回了周一涨幅的很大一部分，霍尔木兹附近再有船只遇袭后，1月原油结算走高。

watch.en: Bowman speaks at 20:25 Beijing. October PCE, the GDP revision, and jobless claims are at 21:30. The Beige Book is at 03:00. OPEC+ meets this weekend. Huang testifies on 3 December.
watch.zh: 鲍曼在北京时间20:25讲话。10月PCE、GDP修正值和初请失业金在21:30。褐皮书在03:00。欧佩克+本周末开会。黄仁勋在12月3日作证。

title.en: Chip shares gave back a large part of Monday's jump
title.zh: 芯片股吐回了周一涨幅的很大一部分

fact.en: The Dow rose 0.85% to 50018.70, the S&P 500 fell 0.5% to 7201.09, and the Nasdaq fell 1.48% to 23733.54, CNBC reported. Nvidia fell 5.86% to 155.38 dollars and the Philadelphia semiconductor index fell 7.88%, while Anthropic fell 6.54% to 81.91 dollars, below the 83 dollar IPO price, Caixin reported.
fact.zh: CNBC：道指上涨0.85%至50018.70，标普500下跌0.5%至7201.09，纳斯达克下跌1.48%至23733.54。财新：英伟达下跌5.86%至155.38美元，费城半导体指数下跌7.88%；Anthropic下跌6.54%至81.91美元，低于83美元的发行价。

mechanism.en: Chip shares reversed a day after the board brought Huang back, so the return did not settle doubt about AI spending and governance. 财经早茶 (24 November): Huang apologized at the all-hands and said he is in therapy every day. US stocks split, with chips and Nvidia down and the Dow up.
mechanism.zh: 董事会请回黄仁勋的第二天，芯片股就转跌，回归并没有消除对人工智能支出和治理的疑问。财经早茶（11月24日）：黄仁勋在全员会上道歉，并说他每天接受心理治疗。美股分化，芯片股和英伟达下跌，道指上涨。

title.en: The five-year yield fell while the two-year yield stayed put
title.zh: 五年期收益率下降，两年期收益率没动

fact.en: The US Treasury 2-year yield is 4.63%, the same as 23 November, the 5-year yield is 4.69% after 4.74% on 23 November, and the 10-year yield is 4.91% after 4.92%. The 30-year yield is 5.30% after 5.29% on 23 November.

mechanism.en: Treasury prices rose because technology shares weakened, and the middle of the curve led, while the two-year yield stayed put. CICC (8 November): tighter rules on AI could slow financing demand and ease some of the upward pressure on Treasury yields. Treasury prices rose, led by the five-year.
mechanism.zh: 科技股走弱，国债价格上涨，曲线中段领涨，两年期收益率没有变化。中金（11月8日）：更严的人工智能规则可能放慢融资需求，并减轻国债收益率的一部分上行压力。国债价格上涨，五年期领涨。

title.en: Gold fell as investors weighed further rate increases
title.zh: 投资者权衡进一步加息，金价下跌

fact.en: Conference Board consumer confidence rose 11.4 points in November to 103.3, the highest in nearly two years and above every forecast in the Bloomberg survey, 财经早茶 reported. Gold fell as investors weighed the chance of further rate increases, 财经早茶 reported.
fact.zh: 财经早茶：美国消费者信心指数11月上升11.4点至103.3，为近两年来最高，高于彭博调查中所有经济学家的预期。投资者权衡进一步加息的可能性，金价下跌。

mechanism.en: Gold fell on a day when the middle of the Treasury curve rallied, so the metal and the bond bid were answering different questions. 财经早茶 (24 November): investors weighed further rate increases after confidence jumped to a nearly two-year high. Gold prices fell.
mechanism.zh: 国债曲线中段上涨的同一天金价下跌，金属和债市买盘回答的不是同一个问题。财经早茶（11月24日）：信心跳升至近两年高点之后，投资者在权衡进一步加息。金价下跌。

title.en: Attacks near Hormuz lifted crude in a quiet session
title.zh: 交投清淡，霍尔木兹附近的袭击推高原油

fact.en: January Brent settled up 2.27% at 91.40 dollars a barrel, and January WTI settled up 2.35% at 82.05 dollars, CNBC reported. That January settle is a different quote from the Yahoo BZ=F row in the snapshot. More tanker attacks outweighed the latest diplomacy on the US-Iran war, and trading was quiet, 财经早茶 reported.
fact.zh: CNBC：1月布伦特上涨2.27%至每桶91.40美元，1月WTI上涨2.35%至82.05美元。这个1月结算价和快照里的Yahoo BZ=F不是同一报价。财经早茶：更多油轮遇袭的报道盖过了美伊战争的最新外交努力，交投清淡。

mechanism.en: Attacks near Hormuz lifted crude in a quiet session, while ample supply still sits in the background. Gelber (24 November): excess supply continues to limit the rebound, so the price hinges on whether further attacks actually stop deliveries. Brent and WTI both settled higher.
mechanism.zh: 霍尔木兹附近的袭击在清淡交投中推高了原油，供应充裕仍在背景里。Gelber（11月24日）：过剩供应仍在限制反弹，价格取决于进一步的袭击是否真的打断交付。布伦特和WTI都结算走高。

title.en: Copper fell to its lowest since December 2025
title.zh: 铜价跌至2025年12月以来最低

fact.en: Copper fell to its lowest since December 2025 as selling in technology giants pulled down stocks and commodities, 财经早茶 reported.
fact.zh: 财经早茶：科技巨头遭抛售拖累股市和大宗商品，铜价跌至2025年12月以来的最低水平。

mechanism.en: Copper fell alongside technology shares, which means the drop followed risk cutting in equities. 财经早茶 (24 November): the price is the lowest since December 2025. Copper prices fell.
mechanism.zh: 铜和科技股一起下跌，这次下跌跟着的是股票里的风险削减。财经早茶（11月24日）：价格是2025年12月以来的最低水平。铜价下跌。

title.en: European stocks fell again while German bond prices rose
title.zh: 欧洲股市再度下跌，德国国债价格上涨

fact.en: German government bond prices rose, and European stocks resumed their recent decline, as technology shares fell and reports of new US tariffs drew safety buying, 财经早茶 reported.
fact.zh: 财经早茶：科技股下挫以及有关美国将推出新一轮关税的报道激发避险买盘，德国国债上涨，欧洲股市重拾近期跌势。

mechanism.en: European stocks fell again while German bond prices rose, a safety bid linked to technology shares and tariff headlines. Simkus (24 November): with price pressure spreading beyond oil, taking rates up to a level that restrains the economy is prudent. European stocks fell, and German bond prices rose.
mechanism.zh: 欧洲股市再度下跌，德国国债价格上涨，这是跟科技股和关税标题连在一起的避险买盘。Simkus（11月24日）：价格压力从石油向外蔓延，把利率上调到开始抑制经济的水平是审慎的。欧洲股市下跌，德国国债价格上涨。

title.en: Tariff preparations sit beside a longer mineral-export pause
title.zh: 关税准备与更长的矿产出口暂停并排

fact.en: The US is preparing to raise tariffs on goods from China, the EU, and more than a dozen other economies as soon as Tuesday, under a 1974 Trade Act Section 301 inquiry into manufacturing overcapacity, 财经早茶 reported. China extended the pause on export limits for gallium, germanium, and antimony, 财经早茶 reported.
fact.zh: 财经早茶：美国准备最早于周二提高对来自中国、欧盟以及其他十多个经济体商品的关税，贸易代表办公室料将完成依据《1974年贸易法》第301条针对制造业产能过剩展开的调查。中国延长了对镓、锗和锑出口限制的暂停期。

mechanism.en: A tariff step is close, and China at the same time extended a pause on exports of gallium, germanium, and antimony. 财经早茶 (24 November): the US is preparing higher tariffs on China, the EU, and other economies under a Section 301 inquiry into manufacturing overcapacity. The tariff risk can move shares, and the mineral pause loosens one supply limit.
mechanism.zh: 关税措施已经很近，中国同时延长了镓、锗和锑出口限制的暂停。财经早茶（11月24日）：美国正依据针对制造业产能过剩的301调查，准备提高对中国、欧盟和其他经济体的关税。关税风险可以带动股价，矿产暂停放松了一项供应限制。

title.en: Bitcoin gave back the equity bounce within hours
title.zh: 比特币在数小时内吐回了股市的反弹

fact.en: Bitcoin gave back the Nvidia rally in less than six hours and is back at its summer lows, and US spot bitcoin ETFs lost 4.3 billion dollars over the past 20 trading days, Glassnode reported. The realized price is 53200 dollars, Glassnode reported.
fact.zh: Glassnode：比特币在不到六小时内吐回英伟达行情，回到夏季低点；过去20个交易日美国现货比特币ETF净流出43亿美元。已实现价格为53200美元。

mechanism.en: Bitcoin gave the equity bounce back within hours, ahead of the later stock selling. Glassnode (24 November): price is back at the summer lows, US spot ETFs have been net sellers, and a firm break of those lows would open the realized price. Bitcoin already reversed the bounce.
mechanism.zh: 比特币在数小时内吐回了股市反弹，早于后来的股票抛售。Glassnode（11月24日）：价格回到夏季低点，美国现货ETF一直在净卖出，若坚定跌破这些低点，就会通向已实现价格。比特币已经扭转了那次反弹。

text.en: The Nasdaq 100 fell hard on Tuesday as chip shares were sold again.
text.zh: 纳斯达克100指数周二重挫，芯片股抛售再度拖累市场。

text.en: The Golden Dragon China index rose. Yum China and Vipshop contributed the most.
text.zh: 金龙中国指数上涨，百胜中国和唯品会控股对指数贡献最大。

text.en: Treasury prices rose, led by the middle of the curve, as weaker technology shares lifted demand for safer bonds. The five-year auction was solid.
text.zh: 美国国债走高，收益率曲线中段领涨，科技股走弱令避险情绪升温。5年期美国国债拍卖表现稳健。

text.en: The dollar fell against most Group of Ten currencies after fresh doubt about the AI trade pushed stocks down.
text.zh: 美元兑多数G10货币走弱，此前对AI交易持续性的质疑重燃推动股市下跌。

text.en: German bond prices rose. A drop in technology shares and reports of a new round of US tariffs drew buyers. European stocks resumed their recent decline.
text.zh: 德国国债上涨，科技股下挫以及有关美国将推出新一轮关税的报道激发避险买盘。欧洲股市重拾近期跌势。

text.en: Oil prices rose in quiet trading. Reports of more tanker attacks outweighed the latest diplomacy aimed at the US-Iran war.
text.zh: 油价在清淡交投中走高，有关更多油轮遇袭的报道盖过了为解决美伊战争所作的最新外交努力。

text.en: Copper fell to its lowest since December last year, as selling in technology giants pulled down stocks and commodities. Gold fell as investors weighed the chance of further rate increases.
text.zh: 铜价跌至去年12月以来的最低水平，科技巨头遭抛售拖累股市和大宗商品；金价下跌，投资者权衡进一步加息的可能性。

source.label: 彭博 Markets Daily China / 财经早茶

globalRegime.en: US stocks split after Monday's surge. Chips and the Nasdaq fell, and the Dow rose. January crude settled higher after more attacks near Hormuz. The five-year Treasury yield fell while the two-year yield stayed put.
globalRegime.zh: 周一暴涨之后，美股走势分化。芯片股和纳斯达克下跌，道指上涨。霍尔木兹附近再有船只遇袭后，1月原油结算走高。五年期国债收益率下降，两年期收益率没有变化。

text.en: The US is preparing to raise tariffs on China, the EU, and more than a dozen other economies as soon as Tuesday local time. The trade representative is expected to finish a 1974 Trade Act Section 301 inquiry into manufacturing overcapacity, and the administration wants new measures to replace tariffs the Supreme Court struck down, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：美国准备最早于当地时间周二提高对中国、欧盟以及其他十多个经济体商品的关税。贸易代表办公室料将完成依据《1974年贸易法》第301条针对制造业产能过剩展开的调查。特朗普政府正寻求以新的措施取代此前被最高法院推翻的关税。

text.en: Nvidia chief executive Huang apologized to staff in a heavy tone at an all-hands and said he is in therapy every day to address the conduct that led to his short exit, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：英伟达首席执行官黄仁勋在公司全体大会上用沉重的语气向员工道歉，并透露为纠正导致自己短暂下台的行为，他每天都在接受心理治疗。

text.en: Less than three hours after the board restored Huang, Chinese state media urged caution and said there is little reason to expect Washington to ease restrictions. The Global Times called for vigilance, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：在英伟达董事会宣布黄仁勋复职不到三个小时，中国官方媒体迅速发出谨慎的声音，认为没有太多理由期待华盛顿放松相关限制。《环球时报》呼吁中国提高警惕。

text.en: US consumer confidence rose 11.4 points in November to 103.3, the highest in nearly two years and above every economist in a Bloomberg survey. Households sounded more optimistic on the economy and jobs, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：美国消费者信心指数11月上升11.4点至103.3，为近两年来最高水平，超出彭博调查中所有经济学家的预期，显示民众对经济和就业市场的看法更加乐观。

text.en: On its fourth day of trading Anthropic fell through the IPO price, and the paper gains of investors who rushed into the record listing last week were gone, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：Anthropic上市后第四日股价重挫并跌破IPO发行价，上周蜂拥参与这家人工智能公司创纪录上市交易的投资者浮盈尽数蒸发。

text.en: The LME is tightening rules after a large squeeze in aluminum. The threshold for the next-day lending guidance falls from 50% of available stock to 30%, and holders of large positions for more than five days face stricter lending terms, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：伦敦金属交易所采取措施应对扰乱铝市场的大规模逼空，所谓的次日展期借贷指引对于铝的适用门槛将从持有可用库存的50%下调至30%，并对持有大额头寸超过五天的交易商实施更严格的借贷要求。

text.en: Saudi authorities said Houthi forces hit a building in a main commercial district of Riyadh and injured 11 people. The strike came less than a week after an attack on the Public Investment Fund headquarters in the same area, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：沙特当局表示，胡塞武装袭击利雅得主要商业区的一座大楼，造成11人受伤。此次袭击距离其袭击同一区域内的沙特公共投资基金总部还不到一周。

text.en: NBC, citing an unnamed US official and a person familiar with the talks, reported that administration officials are debating whether to put senior Iranian leaders on a target list, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：NBC援引一名未具名美国官员和一名知情人士报道，特朗普政府官员正在内部辩论是否应将伊朗高层领导人列为打击目标。

text.en: Ukraine's President Zelensky told Bloomberg that if there is no peace deal Kyiv can accept, he will go to the new Democrat-led US Congress to seek more pressure on Russia, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：乌克兰总统泽连斯基接受彭博采访时表示，如果未能达成基辅可以接受的和平协议，他将与民主党掌控的新一届美国国会接触，寻求加大对俄罗斯的施压。

text.en: Pimco chief investment officer Daniel Ivascyn said the AI boom makes the US economy more exposed to shocks and volatility, which strengthens the case for Treasuries and other high-grade bonds, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：Pimco首席投资官Daniel Ivascyn称，人工智能热潮正令美国经济更容易受到冲击和市场波动影响，这强化了配置美国国债及其他优质债券的理由。

text.en: Trend-following quant funds cut long-held short positions in Treasuries as the stock selloff revived demand for safety, which added to the rise in bond prices, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：随着股市抛售重新激发避险需求，追逐趋势的量化基金削减长期持有的美国国债空头头寸，进一步推动债市上涨。

text.en: Citadel's net trading revenue in the first nine months of 2026 exceeded 15 billion dollars, already past the full-year record set in 2025, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：城堡证券2026年前九个月净交易收入超过150亿美元，已打破2025年全年创下的纪录。

text.en: ECB council member Simkus said that with price pressure spreading out from oil, raising rates to a level that starts to restrain the economy is prudent, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：欧洲央行管委Simkus表示，随着价格压力从石油领域向外蔓延，欧洲央行将利率上调至开始抑制经济的水平，是审慎之举。

text.en: Fitch said the macro credit environment for North American and Western European sovereigns is still on a deteriorating track next year, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：惠誉评级表示，北美和西欧主权国家的宏观信用环境明年总体仍将处于恶化轨道。

text.en: Iraq is pushing back on outside advisers who put its maximum oil capacity under 5 million barrels a day, which could clash at this weekend's OPEC+ meeting on output targets, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：伊拉克对外部顾问有关其最大石油产能不足500万桶/日的评估提出异议，这可能会在本周末欧佩克+关于产量目标的会议上引发冲突。

text.en: BlockBeats reported that Huang told staff the board restored him after finding no national-security threat, and that he is in therapy for an hour and a half a day.
text.zh: 律动：黄仁勋对员工表示，董事会是在确认不存在国家安全威胁后恢复其职务，他目前每天接受一个半小时心理治疗。

text.en: Yicai reported that Monday's rebound lasted one session, and that a hawkish Federal Reserve is still part of what investors are weighing.
text.zh: 第一财经：周一的反弹只维持了一个交易日，更鹰派的美联储仍是投资者在权衡的内容。

text.en: If the tariff step is announced, the safety bid in Treasuries and German bonds can extend, and chip shares can stay heavy.
text.zh: 若关税措施宣布，国债和德国国债里的避险买盘可能延续，芯片股可能继续承压。

text.en: If October core PCE comes in above the forecast listed in the diary, the two-year yield can still reprice a hike after staying flat on Tuesday.
text.zh: 若10月核心PCE高于日程里的预估，两年期收益率在周二持平之后，仍可能重新计入加息。

globalTensions.en: Chips fell and the Dow rose. Oil rose while gold and copper fell. The middle of the Treasury curve rallied after consumer confidence jumped to a nearly two-year high. The dollar fell against most major currencies.
globalTensions.zh: 芯片股下跌，道指上涨。原油上涨，黄金和铜下跌。消费者信心跳升至近两年高点之后，国债曲线中段上涨。美元兑多数主要货币走弱。

chinaStance.en: The PBOC is rolling the one-year medium-term lending facility in a smaller size, so medium-term funds may end several months of net injection, while it pre-announced seven-day reverse repos to cover the month turn. China extended the pause on gallium, germanium, and antimony export limits as Washington prepares higher tariffs.
chinaStance.zh: 中国央行缩量续作一年期中期借贷便利，中长期资金可能结束连续数月的净投放，同时提前预告了呵护跨月的七天期逆回购。中国延长了镓、锗和锑出口限制的暂停期，华盛顿则在准备更高的关税。

text.en: China's commerce ministry on Tuesday extended the pause on export limits for some critical minerals, including gallium, germanium, and antimony. The decision is a test of whether the calmer stretch between the two economies can hold after new US rules on advanced semiconductors, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中国商务部周二延长对部分关键矿产实施的对美出口限制暂停期，涉及镓、锗和锑等。在本月美国出台限制中国获取先进半导体的新规后，这一决定被视为对两大经济体之间的缓和能否维持的一次考验。

text.en: China's commerce ministry urged Mexico to take seriously China's concerns on tariffs and to use trade remedies with care, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中国商务部敦促墨西哥重视涉华关税等严正关切，审慎使用贸易救济措施。

text.en: The EU put temporary import quotas on hybrid cars from China and other places and opened a trade inquiry that is expected to end in limits lasting several years, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：欧盟对来自中国等地的混合动力汽车实施临时进口限额，同时展开一项贸易调查，预计最终将对这类汽车进入欧盟市场实施为期数年的限制。

text.en: China's commerce ministry said it will firmly defend the legitimate rights of the industries involved, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中国商务部回应称，将坚决维护中国相关产业正当权益。

text.en: A US court found Huawei guilty on several criminal counts, including bank fraud tied to Iran business and money laundering. The company was acquitted on racketeering and obstruction of justice, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中国科技巨头华为被裁定多项美国刑事指控罪名成立，包括在伊朗业务问题上欺诈银行以及洗钱。该公司在另外两项指控敲诈勒索和妨碍司法中获判无罪。

text.en: The PBOC rolled over November's one-year medium-term lending facility in a smaller size, so medium-term funds may end several months of net injection. Analysts said that, with funding already ample, the step can help keep long-bond yields in a reasonable range, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：中国央行11月份缩量续作一年期中期借贷便利，本月中长期资金有望结束连续数月净投放态势。分析认为在资金较充裕之际，此举有利于引导长债收益率在合理区间运行。

text.en: The central bank also, for the first time, pre-announced the next day's operation, a 500 billion yuan seven-day reverse repo, to support funding over the month turn, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：央行周二也首次提前预告次日将开展5000亿元七天期逆回购操作，呵护跨月资金面。

text.en: Xinhua reported that Chen Jining, a Politburo member and Shanghai party secretary, is under investigation by the central discipline and supervision commissions for serious violations, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：新华社报道，中共中央政治局委员、上海市委书记陈吉宁因涉嫌严重违纪违法，正接受中央纪委国家监委审查调查。

text.en: Hong Kong plans to tie some hedge-fund tax breaks to the results of a single portfolio rather than the whole fund, to attract strong managers inside multi-manager platforms, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：香港计划将部分对冲基金税务优惠与单个投资组合的业绩挂钩，而非基金整体回报，以增强对多经理平台中绩优基金经理的吸引力。

text.en: Boeing won an order for 50 single-aisle jets from Xiamen Airlines, a China Southern unit. It is the first large purchase by a Chinese airline from the US planemaker in years, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：波音获得中国南方航空旗下厦门航空的50架单通道飞机订单，这是多年来中国航司首次向这家美国飞机制造商进行大规模采购。

text.en: Xiaomi's revenue for the three months to September fell 5.2% from a year earlier to CNY107.24bn (1072.40), the third straight quarterly decline, 财经早茶 and Caixin reported. Adjusted net profit was CNY4.884bn (48.84), down 56.8% from a year earlier, Caixin reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶、财新：小米截至9月的三个月营收同比下降5.2%至1072.40亿元（107.24），为连续第三个季度下降。财新：经调整净利润48.84亿元（4.884），同比下降56.8%。

text.en: Shein agreed to pay 100 million dollars to settle a US Federal Trade Commission case alleging the fast-fashion retailer misled consumers on goods, suppliers, and reviews, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：希音同意支付1亿美元，以了结美国联邦贸易委员会对这家中国快时尚零售商在商品、供应商和消费者评价方面欺骗消费者的指控。

text.en: Kunming Airport Investment Development sold a bond this week at a 5% coupon, another rare high-cost deal by a state firm in the onshore market this year. The disturbance from Zhuhai Huafa's credit stress is still showing, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：昆明空港投资开发集团有限公司本周以5%的利率完成一笔债券发行，成为今年境内债市国企高成本发行的又一罕见案例，显示珠海华发集团信用风波对市场的扰动仍在持续。

text.en: Huafa's board agreed to drop a plan to issue up to 3 billion yuan of A-shares to its controlling shareholder, Zhuhai Huafa Group, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：华发股份董事会同意终止向控股股东珠海华发集团发行不超过30亿元人民币A股。

text.en: An S&P Global Ratings report said Qiao Yin's convertible-bond episode this month shows municipal environmental firms in a phase of tougher competition for existing business and pressure on receivables, while special-bond issuance and debt-resolution policy are still feeding funds into the sector, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：标普信评报告称，环卫服务企业侨银股份本月的可转债事件折射出市政环保行业当前所处存量竞争加剧与应收账款承压的周期阶段，但专项债的持续发行与化债政策的组合效应正为环保行业注入资金活水。

text.en: Hon Hai is seeking to raise up to 1.5 billion dollars by selling a zero-coupon convertible bond, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：鸿海精密据悉寻求通过发行零息可转换债券筹集至多15亿美元。

text.en: DeepSeek founder Liang Wenfeng's wealth jumped 45% to 55 billion dollars after the Chinese AI lab's latest funding round, which left him as the richest builder of an AI model, 财经早茶 reported.
text.zh: 财经早茶：DeepSeek创始人梁文锋的财富额飙升45%，达到550亿美元。这家中国人工智能初创公司完成了最新一轮融资，巩固了梁文锋作为全球最富有AI模型创建者的地位。

text.en: If the smaller MLF rollover becomes the pattern, long-bond yields can stay inside the range the central bank is trying to guide, as long as funding stays ample.
text.zh: 若缩量续作中期借贷便利成为常态，在资金仍然充裕的情况下，长债收益率可以留在央行试图引导的区间里。

text.en: If the pause on critical-mineral export limits is what Beijing offers while Washington prepares tariffs, the tariff step is the larger near-term trade risk for Chinese exporters.
text.zh: 若北京以延长关键矿产出口限制暂停来应对华盛顿准备中的关税，那么对中国出口商来说，更近的贸易风险是关税这一步。

chinaDivergences.en: Oil rose while gold and copper fell. The Dow rose while the Nasdaq fell. The two-year Treasury yield stayed put while the five-year yield fell. Onshore policy is a smaller MLF rollover plus a pre-announced repo, which is a different mix from the tariff headline.
chinaDivergences.zh: 原油上涨，黄金和铜下跌。道指上涨，纳斯达克下跌。两年期国债收益率没动，五年期收益率下降。境内政策是缩量续作中期借贷便利加上提前预告的逆回购，和关税标题不是同一件事。

note.en: Dates run from this briefing, 25 November, through next Friday, 4 December. Rows marked China are mainland China only. No Federal Reserve policy decision falls in these dates. The next decision is scheduled for 9 December. After the November switch to standard time, a decision at 14:00 US Eastern is 03:00 Beijing the next day.
note.zh: 日期从本期简报的11月25日到下周五12月4日。标为中国的，只包括中国内地。这段时间没有美联储议息决定。下一次决定排在12月9日。11月已经切换到标准时间，如果美联储在美东时间14:00做决定，就是次日北京时间03:00。

event.en: PBOC conducts an 800 billion yuan one-year MLF operation and 500 billion yuan of seven-day reverse repos
event.zh: 中国央行开展8000亿元一年期MLF操作和5000亿元七天期逆回购

event.en: Fed vice chair for supervision Bowman speaks
event.zh: 美联储负责监管的副主席鲍曼讲话

event.en: US October personal income and spending
event.zh: 美国10月个人收入与个人支出

event.en: US October core PCE price index
event.zh: 美国10月核心个人消费支出价格指数
美国上周首次申领失业救济人数

event.en: US October durable goods orders, advance
event.zh: 美国10月耐用品订单初值

event.en: US stock market closed for Thanksgiving
event.zh: 美国股市因感恩节休市
融资买入保证金下限降至80%

event.zh: 黄仁勋出席参议院银行委员会听证会

note.en: Equities, FX, gold futures, and Brent futures use the latest Yahoo daily bar; a session still open at the snapshot is intraday, not a close (Brent row is Yahoo BZ=F — not the same print as the CNBC settle); US Treasuries use the official daily yield curve (bp vs prior print); BTC is CoinGecko 24h change; funding compares adjacent OKX prints. Snapshot captured at generate time — not live on the page.
note.zh: 股票、外汇、黄金期货和布伦特期货采用 Yahoo 最近日线柱；快照时尚未收盘的时段是盘中，不是收盘（布伦特一行是 Yahoo BZ=F，与 CNBC 结算价不是同一报价）；美国国债采用官方日度收益率曲线（相对前值的基点）；比特币为 CoinGecko 的 24 小时变动；资金费率比较相邻的 OKX 报价。快照取自生成时点，不是本页实时行情。

printNote.zh: CNBC报道1月合约结算价91.40美元，上涨2.27%。这一行是Yahoo BZ=F报价。
